9.long_description:
Calling all classic pinball fans! This Eight Ball Fury pinball machine brings the "Retro Classic" fun to any game room. It's a perfect blend of challenge and entertainment, with an eye-catching design that won't overwhelm you. It's ideal for players who prefer timeless themes over modern bells and whistles. Built with commercial-grade quality, this pinball machine is sure to provide years of lasting enjoyment.

  • Knocking down any of the six “pocket” drop targets will begin a timed challenge, you have 40 seconds to knock down all 6 drop targets, each time you drop a target 5 seconds will be added to the clock. If you can drop them all down in order an extra bonus will be awarded. (Owner can easily adjust all timings to fine tune the difficulty level anytime). Then onto challenge 2.
  • You have 50 seconds to hit all 7 ball targets (1,2,3,4,5,6,7 Then centre 8 Ball) or (9,10,11,12,13,14,15 Then centre 8 Ball) depending on which player you are. Each time you drop a target 5 seconds will be added to the clock. When all 8 targets have been made Eight Ball Fury 4 ball Multi-Ball Play will begin. Next shoot for alternating Jackpot & Super Jackpot shots. Again, if you can hit each target in order an extra bonus will be awarded. (Owner can easily adjust all timings to fine tune the difficulty level anytime also).
  • Both modes above will add a bonus of 1000 points for each second left on the clock when you complete each challenge.
  • 2 Ball Multi-Ball starts when all 4 B A L L lanes are completed (Use flippers to change lanes). This will also increase the spinner score to 1000 points per spin.
  • Alternating shots to the centre Horseshoe is used to increase end of ball Bonus, 2x,3x,4x,5x, then onto shoot for the extra ball. If you have the highest number of loops ever made your initials will be added to the “hall of fame” along with the current top four highest scores and the players initials are stored.
